# `mutable-pointer-parameter`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a `*T` parameter whose pointee is only read.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`*const T` documents the callee's contract and allows callers to pass immutable
values.

## When it fires

It skips callbacks, `deinit` conventions, escaping addresses, mutable captures,
loops, and other cases where indirect mutation is uncertain.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn total(p: *u32) u32 {
    return p.* + 1;
}
```
